from.place: proof, finite flatness identifies f_*O_X as a finite locally free module, with rank locally constant

title: Pushforward of a finite flat morphism is locally free of locally constant rank
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then $f_*\mathcal O_X$ is a finite locally free $\mathcal O_Y$-module: there is an open cover of $Y$ on which it is isomorphic to $\mathcal O_Y^{\oplus d}$, with the rank $d$ locally constant on $Y$ (equivalently, $Y$ is a disjoint union of open-and-closed pieces on which the rank is constant).

proof.text: By the definition [def-pc-finite-locally-free], $f$ is finite locally free (it is finite, flat and locally of finite presentation). Applying [lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-free-degree-locally-constant] to $f:X\to Y$ (with the roles of the letters $X,Y$ there exchanged) gives a decomposition $Y=\coprod_{d\ge0}Y_d$ into open and closed subsets $Y_d$ such that, with $X_d=f^{-1}(Y_d)$, the restriction $f_d:X_d\to Y_d$ is finite locally free of degree $d$.

For each $d$, [lem-pc-flf-properties] applied to $f_d$ shows that $(f_d)_*\mathcal O_{X_d}$ is a locally free $\mathcal O_{Y_d}$-module of rank $d$, i.e. $Y_d$ has an open cover on which it is isomorphic to $\mathcal O^{\oplus d}$. Since $Y_d$ is open in $Y$ and $X_d=f^{-1}(Y_d)$, the definition of the direct image gives $(f_*\mathcal O_X)|_{Y_d}=(f_d)_*\mathcal O_{X_d}$ (both have sections $\mathcal O_X(f^{-1}(V))$ over $V\subset Y_d$). The open sets of these covers, over all $d$, cover $Y$, and on each of them $f_*\mathcal O_X\cong\mathcal O_Y^{\oplus d}$; the rank is constant equal to $d$ on the open and closed piece $Y_d$, hence locally constant on $Y$. (For $d=0$, $Y_0$ is the open and closed set over which $X$ is empty and $f_*\mathcal O_X|_{Y_0}=0$.)

lean.statement: theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_pushforward_unit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] : SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) ((pushforward f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) ∧ ∃ d : Y → ℕ, IsLocallyConstant d ∧ ∀ (U : Y.Opens) (n : ℕ), (∀ y ∈ U, d y = n) → SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (((pushforward f).obj (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).over U) n
